title: ExMeshCNN: An Explainable Convolutional Neural Network Architecture for 3D Shape Analysis

problem.claim: Learning triangular-mesh data with deep neural networks is not straightforward because meshes are non-uniform and irregular.

gap.claim: Existing transformations, descriptors, and direct mesh architectures have limitations involving spatial information loss, scalability, heuristic features, incomplete capture of geodesic and geometric characteristics, and lack of visual explanations.

narrative_sequence.summary: Triangular meshes are used to represent 3D shapes in computer graphics.
Their non-uniform and irregular nature makes deep-neural-network learning difficult.
Converting meshes to voxel grids, point clouds, or multi-view 2D images can lose spatial information and create scalability issues.
Hand-crafted descriptors may be ineffective across environments, while existing direct mesh architectures use heuristic input features and do not fully capture geodesic and geometric characteristics.
Existing model architectures are not designed to provide visual explanations of their decisions.

source_observation.claim: Representing mesh data through simpler structures can cause spatial information loss and scalability issues.

interpretation.claim: Changing data representation may simplify learning while sacrificing properties important to the original domain.

application.claim: When designing a representation for irregular geometric data, evaluate both learning convenience and preservation of spatial structure.

exception.claim: The source does not establish that every transformation necessarily causes unacceptable information loss or scalability problems.

source_observation.claim: Existing direct mesh architectures use heuristic input features, may not fully capture geodesic and geometric characteristics, and lack visual explanations.

interpretation.claim: A model for geometric data may need both domain-sensitive features and mechanisms that expose decision-making.

application.claim: Assess geometric-learning systems for feature fidelity and explanation capability in addition to predictive behavior.

exception.claim: The source does not specify which explanation method or evaluation criteria would establish adequate interpretability.
